text:
marta: Heads up — starting BlueHarbor LoRA merge into rdp-3b-int4 inference pipeline. Need quick compatibility check before canary. Eval pack uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-evals/blueharbor/quick_v2.zip :white_check_mark:

 tim: Got it. What's the special token set? BH model uses a proprietary SEP token <BH_SEP> right?

 eva: Correct. Ran a tiny smoke locally (fp16 base -> LORA merged -> quant int4) — observed summarization ROUGE-L drop: 0.71 -> 0.68. Invoice amount extraction skewed; example below.

 sanjay: Can you paste the example inputs/outputs? I want to check tokenization boundaries and numeric rounding.

 eva: Sure — Input: "Invoice #12345: Total $1,234.56"; Baseline: "Total 1234.56"; Merged/int4: "Total 1234.0" (lost .56)

 dana: I ran the merge with the usual hf-safetensors stitch: 
```
python merge_lora.py --base rdp-3b --lora blueharbor_v2.safetensors --out merged-bh-rdp3b.safetensors --freeze-embeddings
```
Got a warning: "WARN: tokenizer token id 50277 not found -> mapped to <unk>". Might be the SEP token mapping.

 marta: That warning is critical. If embeddings remap, quantization will amplify numeric drift. Tim — can you try remapping the tokenizer and rerun with embedding freeze off/on?

 tim: Running now. Quick note: for int4 we should also try per-channel quant + KV cache clipping. Command I'm using:
```
hf_convert --model merged-bh-rdp3b.safetensors --quant 4 --perchannel --kv-clip 0.98 --out merged-bh-rdp3b-int4
```

 ci-bot: auto-smoke: unit tests OK. smoke-eval summary uploaded: https://storage.redwood.internal/blueharbor/smoke_v2/report.html

 sanjay: If remap fixes token id, we can retest. Also try merging LoRA with 'freeze-embeddings' toggled — sometimes freezing causes OOV remap differences.

 eva: After remap -> lexer patch, ROUGE-L improved to 0.70 and invoice extraction restored to "1234.56" in 8/10 examples. Still one outlier. Full evalpack stats: Precision 0.96 -> 0.94, F1 0.81 -> 0.78

 marta: OK. Plan: 1) tim will run remap + per-channel int4 and post metrics, 2) eva run full quickpack across 1000 samples, 3) if regression >2 pts on key metrics, route BlueHarbor to int8 fallback for Canary. Adding @tim @eva to the canary run tomorrow 09:30 PST.

 tim: On it. Will post logs here once done. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

 dana: created ticket INF-4272 with steps and sample that failed. Tagging infra for rollout gating.

 marta: Thanks team — good progress. We'll reconvene after tim's run. :thumbsup:
